step1_analysis.description: A cascoded inverter used as a high-gain amplifier in an incremental zoom-ADC. The paper mentions it is dynamically biased for PVT immunity, though the dynamic bias switches (XMP21, XMN21) appear tied to inactive states (VDD, GND) in this static netlist extraction.

paper_reference.title: A 6.3μW 20b Incremental Zoom-ADC with 6ppm INL and 1μV Offset

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. With the cascode architecture, Rout is high. Assuming gm ~ 1mS and Rout ~ 1MOhm, gain is ~60dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact bias point and whether the input devices enter the triode region due to the fixed cascode bias voltages.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_VDD. With Vtrip ~ 0.8V and W/L=10, Id ~ 200uA. Power ~ 360uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The default W/L of 5u/0.5u leads to higher current than the ultra-low power reported in the paper, which likely used subthreshold biasing or smaller W/L.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm / (2*pi*CL). For gm=1mS and CL=1pF, UGF ~ 160MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard metric for amplifiers to determine bandwidth and settling speed.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Phase at UGF for a single-pole dominant system is ~90 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Crucial for stability in closed-loop ADC integrator operation.

vtrip.description: DC trip point voltage where Vout = Vin

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the balance of PMOS and NMOS strengths. Since un > up and W/L are equal, Vtrip < VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sets the input common-mode level for the amplifier.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC trip point, power consumption, open-loop gain, UGF, and phase margin of the cascoded inverter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cascoded Inverter Amplifier Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmp22=5u L_xmp22=0.5u
.param W_xmn22=5u L_xmn22=0.5u
.param W_xmn21=5u L_xmn21=0.5u
.param W_xmn1=5u L_xmn1=0.5u
.param W_xmp21=5u L_xmp21=0.5u
.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XMP22 VO VB0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp22} w={W_xmp22}
XMN22 VO VB1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn22} w={W_xmn22}
XMN21 N0 GND N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn21} w={W_xmn21}
XMN1 N3 VON GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn1} w={W_xmn1}
XMP21 N4 VDD N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp21} w={W_xmp21}
XMP1 N1 VOP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}
XM2 N0 N0 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N4 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB0 VB0 0 0.99
VVB1 VB1 0 0.54
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9

* Closed loop for DC self-biasing at the trip point
* Huge inductor shorts output to input at DC, open at AC
L1 VO VOP 1G
* Tie VOP and VON together for inverter operation
R1 VOP VON 0
* Huge capacitor couples AC signal without disturbing DC bias
C1 VIN_AC VOP 1G
Vac VIN_AC 0 DC 0 AC 1

* Load Capacitance
CL VO 0 1p

.control
  * 1. Operating Point Analysis
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  let vtrip = v(VO)
  print power vtrip

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(VO)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VO))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
